name: Shrine of Winter
desc:
The **Shrine of Winter** was a location in Deepwoken's Pre-Release phase used to enter the Depths without having to die, similarly to Whirlpools. The Shrine was most likely located in either [Etris](location:etris) or the [Isle of Vigils](location:isle_of_vigils) due to the soundtrack Peregrine playing in the area.

To activate the shrine, a user in its proximity of activation would use a wisp-type ritual (most likely the Frost Wisp,) and would be teleported to [Scyphozia](location:first_layer) instantly.
additional_info:
-   The Shrine of Winter is still present in the game, being behind [Galpin Spellhardt](entity:galpin_spellhardt_musicologist_extraordinaire) in [The Floating Keep](location:the_floating_keep). However, it no longer serves it's original purpose nor can it be used to enter The Depths.
-   The GIF and picture used in this article are from ReEvolu's video Clips from Ancient Deepwoken
